title: Linear Dark Nebula SaaS
tagline: Ultra-refined dark mode hero, glowing mesh gradient, and keyboard-centric bento grid
description: Inspired by Linear.app and Raycast, this design features an obsidian dark theme, subtle radial ambient glow, pill badges, interactive keyboard shortcuts, and a modular bento grid showcasing real-time features.
features: Glassmorphic pill badge with live pulsing beacon
Floating product dashboard with mock task Kanban

aiPrompt.standard: Create a modern Linear.app-inspired SaaS landing page with an obsidian dark theme (#08090d). Include a top glassmorphic navbar with logo and 'Sign In' CTA. In the hero, add a subtle glowing purple/indigo radial background gradient, an animated pill badge 'v2.0 is live', a bold 72px headline with gradient text fill, a 2-line subtitle, and two CTA buttons ('Get Started for Free' and 'Book Demo'). Below the hero, place an interactive mock Kanban dashboard with glowing borders. Follow with a 3-column Bento grid with icon cards, micro-charts, and keyboard shortcut pills (e.g. 'Cmd + K'). Finish with a social proof logo ticker and a clean 4-column footer.

title: Stripe Glow Tiers & Pricing
tagline: Luminescent pricing cards with monthly/yearly billing toggle and interactive feature matrix
description: An elegant, high-conversion pricing page inspired by Stripe and Supabase. Includes annual billing discount badge, highlighted 'Most Popular' tier with neon gradient border, ROI calculator, and FAQ accordion.
features: Billed annually / monthly switch with 'Save 20%' badge
Luminescent highlighted tier with glowing border

aiPrompt.standard: Build a high-conversion SaaS pricing page with 3 tiers: Starter ($19/mo), Pro ($49/mo - marked as Most Popular with glowing indigo gradient border), and Enterprise (Custom). Include an annual vs. monthly billing toggle that applies a 20% discount. Under the cards, add a collapsible FAQ section and a feature comparison table with checkmarks.
aiPrompt.cursorPrompt: Create a Tailwind CSS pricing component with 3 pricing cards on a dark slate background (#0b0f19). Use glowing gradient borders on the middle card (from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500). Add state for billingPeriod (monthly/yearly) with animated toggle.
aiPrompt.v0Prompt: Stripe style pricing page with glowing border cards, annual discount toggle pill, checkmark feature list, and enterprise banner. Dark mode with cyan and violet accents.
aiPrompt.claudePrompt: Generate a complete pricing page with billing toggle, interactive tier cards, detailed feature comparison table, and FAQ accordion using Tailwind CSS and React.
